PLAN "Full 12-Week Upper-Body Strength + Climbing Prep for Subacromial Impingement" 
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Upper-body strength with pain-free loading for subacromial impingement; climbing-specific peak in Phase 3; 12-week progression including hangboard and mobility; 2x cardio to support climbing endurance"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Foundation & pain-free loading":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Foundation & progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_extension 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Stability and control":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload & refine technique":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 2x6..8 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 2x8..12 rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 2x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength build 1":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength build 2":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Volume & balance":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Recovery & technique":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x6..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength peak prep & climb peak prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Strength peak & climb prep":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Peaking taper":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Test & reload + peak for climbing trip":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x3..5 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x5..7 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds

NUTRITION PLAN (body recomposition focus)
TYPE nutrition
OBJECTIVE body_recomposition
CALORIE_TARGET
  DAILY_SURPLUS_OR_DEFICIT maintenance_plus_minus:
    note "Begin at maintenance with protein focus; adjust by +/- 100-200 kcal based on weekly weight trends and climbing goals"
PROTEIN
  grams_per_kg 1.6..2.2
FATS
  grams_per_kg 0.8..1.0
CARBS
  remainder_of_calories
MEAL PATTERNS
  - protein at each meal
  - 4-5 meals recommended
  - pre/post workout protein: 20-40g within 2 hours
  - hydration: 2-3 L water
SAMPLE DAILY FRAME
  - breakfast: high protein + complex carbs
  - snack: protein + fruit
  - lunch: protein + carbs + vegetables
  - pre-workout snack: 30-60g carbohydrate if training later
  - post-workout: 20-40g protein + carbs
  - dinner: protein + veggies + fat
SUPPLEMENTATION (where appropriate)
  - protein powder as convenient protein source if protein target not met
  - creatine_monohydrate 3-5g daily (optional, safe for joints)
  - omega_3 if intake is low
  - vitamin_D if deficient (check via blood)
  - calcium if not sufficient
GROCERY LIST (sample)
  - lean proteins: chicken_breast, turkey, fish, eggs, greek_yogurt
  - carbs: oats, rice, potatoes, quinoa, fruits, vegetables
  - fats: olive_oil, nuts, avocado
  - beverages: water, green_tea
MEASUREMENT & ADJUSTMENT
  - track weight weekly; adjust calories by ±100-200 if weight changes more than 0.5 kg/week
  - monitor climbing performance; adjust carbs around long climbing days
  - adjust macros if performance plateaus for 2 weeks

CARDIO PROGRAM (2x/week addition)
TYPE cardio
OBJECTIVE support_climbing_endurance
SCHEDULE
  WEEK 1-4:
    CARDIO_SESSION_1:
      modality: running
      duration: 25 minutes
      intensity: easy-moderate (holds conversation)
    CARDIO_SESSION_2:
      modality: cycling
      duration: 25 minutes
      intensity: easy-moderate
  WEEK 5-8:
    CARDIO_SESSION_1:
      modality: running
      duration: 30 minutes
      intensity: moderate (slightly conversational)
    CARDIO_SESSION_2:
      modality: cycling
      duration: 30 minutes
      intensity: moderate
  WEEK 9-12:
    CARDIO_SESSION_1:
      modality: running
      duration: 35 minutes
      intensity: moderate
    CARDIO_SESSION_2:
      modality: cycling
      duration: 35 minutes
      intensity: moderate

HANGBOARD & CLIMBING-SPECIFIC PREP (Phase 3 onwards)
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks) continued:
    WEEK 9:
      ADD_HANGBOARD_SESSION:
        frequency: 1
        modality: hangboard_training
        duration: 20 minutes
        intensity: pain_free
        notes: "avoid edge depths causing pain; focus on threshold hangs, dead hangs, and open-handed singles; warmup thorough"
      WEEK 10:
        ADD_HANGBOARD_SESSION:
          frequency: 2
          modality: hangboard_training
          duration: 25 minutes
          intensity: pain_free
          notes: "avoid pain; progressive volume via time under tension"
    WEEK 11:
      CLIMBING_SPECIFIC_PREP:
        - "Fingerboard scrambles: controlled attempts on campus/board with pause-releases"
        - "Core stability: Swiss ball or dead bug 3x8-12"
        - "Lock-off strength: 2-sec holds on top of a controlled move"
        - "Campus board micro-movements: light, pain-free, no big loading"
        - "Mobility flow: shoulder-dominant dynamic mobility sequence (5 minutes)"
    WEEK 12:
      CLIMBING_SPECIFIC_PREP:
        - "Technique emphasis: footwork, hip positioning drills"
        - "Endurance: easy long sets on routes up to 25-30 moves with rest intervals"
  MOBILITY PROGRAM
  - Daily mobility routine (5-10 minutes) integrated on training days and rest days
  - Focus areas: thoracic spine, shoulder girdle, scapular motion, hip flexors, lats, pec minor
  - Examples (canonical): thoracic_extension, lat_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, pec_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, quad_stretch, spinal_twist, cat_cow, child_pose

HANGBOARD & CLIMBING-SPECIFIC PREP (Phase 3 onwards) NOTES
  - All hangboard work remains pain-free; avoid crimping beyond tolerance.
  - Integrate climbing days with the upper-body plan to maintain shoulder health; avoid high-volume overhead loading.
  - Include scapular activation warmups before climbing: band_pull_aparts, scapular_pushups, serratus_punches.

MOBILITY PROGRAM
  - Daily mobility routine (5-10 minutes) integrated on training days and rest days
  - Focus areas: thoracic spine, shoulder girdle, scapular motion, hip flexors, lats, pec minor
  - Examples (canonical): thoracic_extension, lat_stretch, chest_stretch, shoulder_stretch, pec_stretch, hip_flexor_stretch, quad_stretch, spinal_twist, cat_cow, child_pose

ADAPTATIONS FOR SHOULDER
- Maintain no overhead loading; use safeties: add face_pull and rotator cuff-friendly RC health moves.
- Monitor subacromial symptoms; if pain increases, scale back climbing intensity or adjust hangboard intensity.

SEQUENCING OF EVENTS
- Schedule hangboard and climbing prep in Phase 3 to align with progressive load.
- Alternate with rest days as needed to avoid overtraining.

FINISHER PROGRAM (Saturday full-body finisher)
  - Incorporated weekly in Phase 1-3 as weekly Saturday finisher: 20-minute full-body circuit per earlier plan with 3 rounds.

SEQUENCING OF EVENTS SUMMARY
- Phase 1: technique, pain-free loading, establish base
- Phase 2: strength build, increased volume, maintain RC health
- Phase 3: peak intensity, climbing-specific prep, hangboard progression, finisher continuity
- Cardio supports climbing endurance; dual 2x/week
- Mobility integrated daily; shoulder-focused RC safety
- Saturday finisher kept for engagement and broad activation

NOTES
- No overhead loading remains; cardio remains non-overhead.
- Peak intensity synchronized with Week 12 climb trip; adjust if travel or fatigue demands.
- All canonical exercise vocab is used; no unsupported movements.
